parameter_refs.name: property_traversal_route
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: road only or surveyed property route

quote: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may not proceed on or through any private or public property to enter the intersecting street where traffic is not facing a red signal to avoid the red signal.

activation.condition: Vehicular traffic faces a steady red signal alone.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Purpose cannot be inferred from trajectory alone; retain separate authored controller declaration and original route evidence.

obligation.description: May not proceed on or through any private or public property to enter the intersecting street where traffic is not facing red to avoid the red signal.

timing.description: While the signal is steady red alone and the vehicle traverses the property route into the intersecting street.
